records.quote: Theorem 3.5 For i = 1, 2, ..., n, let Ui and Vi be two sets of mutually independent random variables each following the multiple-outlier Kw-G model such that Ui ∼Kw-G(α, β, F ) and Vi ∼Kw-G(α, δ, F ) for i = 1, 2, . . . , n1 , Ui ∼ Kw-G(α∗ , β ∗ , F ) and Vi ∼ Kw-G(α∗ , δ ∗ , F ) for i = n1 + 1, n1 + 2, . . . , n1 + n2 (= n). If (β, β, . . . , β, β ∗ , β ∗ , . . . , β ∗ ) ≽m (δ, δ, . . . , δ, δ ∗ , δ ∗ , . . . , δ ∗ ) [n1 and n2 copies] and i) α > α∗ , β > β ∗ , δ < δ ∗ , then U1:n ≥lr V1:n ;

records.quote: Theorem 4.4 Let X1 and X2 be two random variables having distribution functions F1 and F2 respectively.
